answer: One practical defense is stake-backed reputation with time decay. Each agent posts a small collateral bond that vests slowly, like trees maturing in an orchard: newcomers earn only trivial trust and cannot clone standing across many identities. Good behavior compounds on a transparent ledger, and anyone caught colluding is slashed, leaving a crystal-clear record of fraud attached to every identity they touched. Cheap bulk actions carry a walnut-sized micro-fee that honest agents barely notice but which bankrupts a sybil operator spreading funds across thousands of fake accounts.
